{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Paleo''''' was a modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], it took part in the [[Battle of Mindor]]. The ''Paleo'', along with the [[Lancer (freightliner)|''Lancer'']], another modified Corellian Frigate, utilized their conveyor belts in rescuing trapped individuals inside the [[Shadow Base]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />{{Ship-stub}}
